Rename is applied consistently across sources, tests, `.env.sample.json`, and devcontainer — no lingering `zerionBalancesEnabled` / `FF_ZERION_BALANCES_CHAIN_IDS` references. A couple of small things worth flagging:

### Issues

**1. `FF_ZERION_ENABLED` parsing is inconsistent with the rest of the flags — `!!` makes `FF_ZERION_ENABLED=false` still truthy** (`src/config/entities/configuration.ts:409`)

```ts
zerionEnabled: !!process.env.FF_ZERION_ENABLED,
```

Every other feature flag in this block uses `.toLowerCase() === 'true'` (lines 407, 408, 412, 415, 416, 418…). With `!!`, any non-empty string — including `"false"`, `"0"`, `"no"` — enables the flag. This was tolerable when the env var was `FF_ZERION_BALANCES_CHAIN_IDS` (a "presence = enable" list), but the new name `FF_ZERION_ENABLED` strongly implies boolean semantics. Operators toggling `FF_ZERION_ENABLED=false` will be surprised.

Suggest aligning with the rest:

```ts
zerionEnabled: process.env.FF_ZERION_ENABLED?.toLowerCase() === 'true',
```

Note this changes semantics vs. `main` (unset would now default to `false`), so the deploy note should be updated: any env that currently just *sets* `FF_ZERION_ENABLED` to any value (e.g. the chain-id list carried over from the legacy var) would need to become `FF_ZERION_ENABLED=true`.

[Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20src%2Fconfig%2Fentities%2Fconfiguration.ts%3A409%20on%20branch%20chore%2Frename-zerion-enabled-flag%2C%20replace%20%60zerionEnabled%3A%20!!process.env.FF_ZERION_ENABLED%60%20with%20%60zerionEnabled%3A%20process.env.FF_ZERION_ENABLED%3F.toLowerCase()%20%3D%3D%3D%20%27true%27%60%20to%20match%20the%20other%20feature%20flags%20in%20the%20same%20block.%20Then%20update%20any%20dependent%20tests%20and%20the%20PR%20deploy%20note%20accordingly.&repo=safe-global/safe-client-gateway)

**2. `.env.sample.json` entry is inconsistent** (`.env.sample.json:753-757`)

```json
{
  "name": "FF_ZERION_ENABLED",
  "description": "Enable Zerion balances provider (OPTIONAL)",
  "defaultValue": true,
  "required": true
}
```

- `description` says `(OPTIONAL)` but `required: true`.
- `defaultValue: true` combined with `!!` parsing means the flag is effectively always on in dev unless the env is unset — misleading.
- Description still says "balances provider"; per the PR body, the flag now gates Zerion as a whole. Consider "Enable Zerion (OPTIONAL)".

### Nits

- `src/modules/balances/datasources/balances-api.manager.spec.ts:81,137` still mocks `features.zerionEnabled`, but `balances-api.manager.ts` doesn't read that key — dead mock (pre-existing under the old name, now carried over). Safe to drop while you're touching this file.

### Otherwise LGTM

- All rename call-sites updated.
- Test expectations updated including the descriptive `it(...)` string on `safes.v2.controller.overview.integration.spec.ts:403`.
- Deploy risk (silent flag drop for envs still on `FF_ZERION_BALANCES_CHAIN_IDS`) is called out in the PR body and confirmed with InfraSec.
